name: Scarlet Subterfuge
label: Quest
description: Scarlet Subterfuge: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I am what you would call, an illusionist. Though I may be able to create an illusion to allow you entry into Hearthglen, be warned; my powers have their limitations.

Should you travel too far from these lands, the effects of the illusion will cease. The spell itself takes a great amount of concentration and power from me, and thus, I can only sustain the effect for a short time.
Speak to me again when you are ready.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Are you the reinforcements from Tyr's Hand?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This... This cannot be true. But all that you have shown me...
Taelan falls to one knee, his heartbeat quickens. The fury of ages is about to be loosed upon this town.
